data.narrative:
LabGenius is a Seed-stage biotech company founded by James Field that has raised $73M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 3 public peers in Biotech & Health (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private comparables including Colossal Biosciences, Chai Discovery, Recursion Pharmaceuticals, and Freenome.

A single valuation method proved applicable: Stage-Progression anchoring. Using the $27M total raised proxy as a base and applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage progression, this approach yields an implied valuation of $68M. The Peer-Median method could not be applied due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables within the narrow biotech filter (0 qualifying peers met clustering criteria; the broader sector set of 7 lacked sufficient homogeneity). Public-Comp Anchoring via P/S multiples was inapplicable because LabGenius revenue is not on file, standard for private companies at this stage.

The triangulated valuation range is $57M to $78M, centered on $68M. This single-method result carries meaningful uncertainty. Key dependencies include the appropriateness of the 2.5x multiplier for this company's specific risk profile and market window, and whether peer capital efficiency differs materially from the proxy assumption. Revenue data and near-term financing terms would strengthen conviction in this range.
